caption: The drawing depicts a single purple glass bowl with a scalloped rim and a wavy, undulating edge. The bowl is centrally placed against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. The glass has a translucent quality, allowing multiple shades of purple to be visible, ranging from light lilac to deep violet. The outer surface of the bowl features elongated oval sections, each with darker and lighter regions to indicate the reflective and transparent properties of the glass. The overall shape is symmetrical, and the structure appears slightly flared towards the top. There is a small inscription in the lower left corner which reads, "John Tarantino."
title: Bowl
